title: Running performance trend and distance conversion assumptions
population: Recreational distance runners (mechanistic prior, not personalized physiology)
definition: Riegel-style distance scaling and default measurement noise for threshold race-time forecasts when direct goal-distance evidence is sparse.
limitations: Riegel conversion is a population heuristic; it is not calibrated to an individual athlete.
Sparse or cross-distance-only evidence remains EXPLORATORY.
Weekly mileage is activity context only and does not inject a fitness score.
Missed sessions are recorded when explicitly observed but do not map to recovery scores.
permitted_use: baseline threshold_trend pricing and exploratory What If perturbation

claims.claim: Distance conversion uses an explicit Riegel exponent; it does not claim personalized physiology.
